sourceDescription: De-identified Volunteer V-01 physical-prototype recording (ESP32-S3 wrist hardware, MAX30102 PPG @ 100 Hz, Grove GSR uncalibrated relative conductance @ 20 Hz, MPU6050 ACC @ 100 Hz) processed offline through the firmware-matched causal filters and seed-52 Random Forest; paired with 23-subject seed-52 LOSO global feature importance and held-out confusion matrix.

caveats.globalImportance: Global impurity-based (MDI) Random Forest importance scores come from the 23-subject final seed-52 fit; they rank average split contribution across trees, not per-window explanations, causal effects, or accuracy shares.
caveats.spectralContext: PRV_MeanNN, EDA_Mean, and EDA_Max are time-domain features. Welch PSD is shown strictly as signal and filter context (60 s windows cannot resolve clinical autonomic spectral ratios or stable very-low-frequency bands).
caveats.calibration: Grove GSR readings use nominal 10-bit conversion estimates (relative skin conductance), not calibrated laboratory microsiemens.
caveats.curatedSelection: These four windows are curated examples demonstrating baseline calibration, cognitive stress, aerobic activity, and cross-class overlap; they do not represent an overall prototype accuracy estimate.

topFeatures.label: Mean pulse interval (PRV_MeanNN)
topFeatures.description: Arithmetic mean of normal-to-normal intervals between accepted IR PPG systolic peaks in the 60 s window.

topFeatures.label: Mean skin conductance (EDA_Mean)
topFeatures.description: Uncentered mean of the 1 Hz low-pass filtered Grove GSR conductance estimate (SCL + SCR) across the 60 s window.

topFeatures.label: Peak skin conductance (EDA_Max)
topFeatures.description: Maximum uncentered value reached by the filtered Grove GSR conductance estimate (SCL + SCR) in the 60 s window.
